welcome.speaker: Muhammad Jan
lines: Welcome to our village in Laghman. Walk with me to the Library; we will begin with a first hello.
Use the arrows or WASD to move. Stand next to a person and press E, Enter or Interact. The paths connect all four neighbourhoods.

onboarding-introduction.speaker: Muhammad Jan
lines: Welcome! Four learning areas are waiting for you: Home for household vocabulary and everyday activities; Lake for nature, water and outdoor vocabulary; Market for food, trading and everyday transactions; and School for learning, reading, writing and grammar.
Explore these areas and speak with the villagers. You can study at your own pace or try the daily challenge when you feel ready.

If you are comfortable typing in English or Pashto, enable optional typing challenges in the Library’s Player Profile settings. They are off by default. The Library also holds your Vocabulary Bank, Grammar Journal, expressions and voluntary review.

2.name: Back to School
2.intro: We will use he and she with the first action verbs, placing the subject, object and verb in their licensed order.
2.objective: Normal: complete School, then study at Home immediately for Muhammad Jan’s check-in. Market and Lake are optional before or after Home. The early challenge remains available at Home.
